scope.initial: HVAC settings presentation, descriptions and translations.
userAdded: One per-HVAC EssentialEnabled flag: excluded from HVAC watt-budget accounting and automatic Peak Guard/energy reduction. Actual P1 still includes consumption as fixed household load.
Explicit Flow permanent-control OFF still works. Temperature, outdoor and stale-input stops remain independent.
Reuse existing upper outdoor-temperature hysteresis field with 0.5 C for missing/new settings; no second hysteresis option or reset of saved margins.
scope.packaging: Regenerated inconsistent existing lock metadata using published dependencies, retaining homey-api 3.19.2 and its exact integrity; repaired four nonexistent transitive versions. jsdom is test-only.

groups: Advanced: periodic heating, shared power, control parameters, outputs/Flow, diagnostics
ui.summary: Four configuration-only parts, updated on relevant user events and existing initialization; explicitly labels selected settings as potentially unsaved. No physical-state prediction.
ui.eventBindings: Two delegated input/change handlers per panel registered once; no repeated binding on reopening.
ui.validation: Opens collapsed advanced section and navigates to the relevant existing device tab before focusing a validation error.

hvacModules: lib/hvac-permanent.js: essential default, current-setting check before delayed energy reductions, existing outdoor hysteresis default/fallback.
lib/hvac-coordination.js: mustSkipOff flag, fixed-source budget partition, Peak Guard/admission exemption, normal publication reservations retained.
runtime.sameConfiguredInputsAndEssentialDisabled: 12 original 1.2.33 traces / 36 decision moments and actual published Flow commands match exactly.

preserved: Flow cards including deprecated definitions byte-identical
README introduction unchanged; release notes at bottom in five languages
skipped: Independent battery, EV, PV, phase, boiler, AutoTune and widget suites
limitations: DOM and storage tested on host; actual Homey mobile/desktop WebView rendering and physical HVAC behavior not tested. Narrow layout uses min-width:0, responsive columns and wrapping, but no native browser layout measurement was possible.
Essential excludes energy shedding only; Flow OFF, room/outdoor limits and stale-input actions can still stop the device as explicitly clarified.
An essential shared physical source is excluded once from the HVAC watt budget, preventing another zone from treating the source as shed-able power.
